name: Field book
idea: Warm paper, ruled lines in place of boxes, a serif for headings and rows roomy enough for a gloved hand, as a surveyor's field book has them.
gives_up: Room. Rows this tall show a supervisor fewer assets at once, and on a landing page the look is quiet

drawn_from.took: Warm paper and coloured ruling in place of boxes, a serif for headings, rows roomy enough to be used outdoors
Colour kept for the state a thing is in, each colour with one meaning the whole depot knows

refuses: No boxes around groups: a ruled line or space tells them apart
No pure white and no pure black

signature.what: Rows ruled in the feint green of a field book, and never boxed
signature.landing: The rule above each benefit, and the table in the picture

signature.what: Headings in a bookish serif over a plain sans
signature.product: Screen titles, section headings and the product's name
signature.landing: The headline and every section heading

meanings.accent: the one thing to do next on a screen, and nothing else
meanings.info: not visited yet, or a note

colour.product_use: Ink blue is on the main action and on links. No area is filled with colour
colour.landing_use: Paper and ink. Colour is on the main action and on links only

motion.product: A panel opens with a short fade
motion.landing: A section fades in once, as it is reached
motion.reduced: Everything appears at once, without a fade

imagery.kind: Photographs the utility has taken of its own assets, and real screens of the product
imagery.treatment: In daylight and uncropped, each with a caption that says what it is and where
imagery.never: Stock photographs, or drawings made to look hand-drawn

voice.speaks_to: the crew or the supervisor, as "you"
voice.tone: Plain and exact, as one colleague to another
voice.capitalisation: Sentence case throughout, and no capitals for emphasis
